fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Supplier for a Subcontractor row, Contractor for an Internal Jobcard row. Set from Work Type (production_plan.validate_process_planning).

fields.label: Supplier/Contractor
fields.description: Who carries out this operation: a Supplier on a Subcontractor row, a Contractor on an Internal Jobcard row. Required before the plan is submitted, and copied onto that operation's Supplier Operation Entry.

fields.label: Create Operation
fields.description: When unchecked, no Supplier Operation Entry is created for this row when the Subcontracting Order is generated.

fields.label: Inspection Mandatory
fields.description: The Supplier Operation Entry created for this row cannot be submitted until an Inspection Entry is completed for it.
